## Quantity

<a id="Angle"></a>

### Angle

`Angle` · `src/angles.ts:25`

How far a direction turns from another, counted in radians (the SI's coherent unit: an arc as long as its radius); a turn is 2π radians, a degree a 360th of a turn.

Source: BIPM, The International System of Units (SI Brochure, 9th edition), Table 4 (radian) and Table 8 (degree) · `https://www.bipm.org/en/publications/si-brochure`

| Unit | Of the base unit |
|---|---|
| `radian` | 1 |
| `degree` | 0.02 |
| `turn` | 6.28 |
